title: To win over working class voters, Democrats need to stop talking about democracy
description: Working class voters have moved away from the Democratic Party. Winning them back is key to the party's future, a new reports shows. But first, the messaging has to change.

title: Trump and Netanyahu meet in D.C. amid tensions over Iran war
description: President Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's latest meeting comes as the U.S. has paused strikes in Iran as the two sides negotiate.

title: Former peace negotiator shares takeaways from Trump's meeting with Netanyahu
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former peace negotiator and advisor to the Israeli government Daniel Levy about takeaways from President Trump's meeting with Israel's prime minister.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83 million verdict in E. Jean Carroll case
description: Trump’s attorneys asserted a 2024 high court decision granting presidents sweeping immunity for actions taken in office shields him from liability in the case.

title: Haitian TPS holders in South Florida brace for end of their legal status
description: Temporary protected status was given to Haitians after the 2010 quake because Haiti was deemed too dangerous for a safe return. In June, the Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to end TPS.

title: Conservatives tout Biden tapes as proof of his decline. The audio is more nuanced.
description: Audio of Joe Biden's interviews with a ghostwriter in 2016 and 2017 show him referencing classified materials and occasionally struggling to recall details.

title: Democrats are focused on affordability. Some say they should focus on democracy too
description: Democratic candidates have focused on affordability. But some party leaders say they also need to talk about democracy, especially if President Trump continues making unfounded claims about election fraud.

title: In a day of tributes, Lindsey Graham is remembered as a tireless Washington mainstay
description: Lawmakers, foreign leaders and President Trump gathered Tuesday for the first of two days of funeral services for the late South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham.

title: This grandma fought for a bill to allow happy hour at retirement homes
description: Anita LeBrun said she hoped to enjoy a drink with her friends, but it was also a matter of independence.

title: Trump to meet with Ukraine's Zelenskyy and Israel's Netanyahu
description: President Trump says he will meet with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu Tuesday setting up a big day of foreign policy.

title: Former Pentagon official on Trump's meetings with the leaders of Ukraine and Israel
description: NPR's A Martínez asks former senior Pentagon official Evelyn Farkas about President Trump's potential priorities as he meets the leaders of Ukraine and Israel.

title: Trump shattered ethics norms. Will voters trust Democrats to fix them?
description: Democrats are making the case that now is the time to tackle anti-corruption reforms — to serve as a check on Donald Trump and to overhaul a system voters say is co-opted against their interests.

title: Police vetted dubious allegation only after Buttigieg was separated from children
description: The Michigan attorney general’s office is investigating how the accusation that prompted the ex-Cabinet secretary's separation from his 4-year-old twins was handled.
